items.title: 台南環保局「淨零同行・永續有成」 展現淨零教育多元成果 | 台灣好新聞
items.summary: 您使用的瀏覽器版本較舊，已不再受支援。建議您更新瀏覽器版本，以獲得最佳使用體驗。為深化淨零教育及永續發展理念，臺南市政府環境保護局21日於全美戲院舉辦「淨零同行・永續有成」成果表揚交流會，邀集淨零種子講師、學校師生、社區及民間團體參與，透過成果分享、頒獎表揚、話劇演出及紀錄片放映，展現臺南推動淨零教育的多元成果。

items.title: EU strikes deal on new ‘sustainable’ and ‘transition’ fund labels for SFDR
items.summary: # EU strikes deal on new ‘sustainable’ and ‘transition’ fund labels for SFDR The European Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement on changes to the Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation (SFDR), including new 'sustainable' and 'transition' categories.

items.title: ISSB urged to make its nature-related disclosure a standard
items.summary: In addition to recommending that the standard be mandatory, TNFD’s letter also recommends the standard-setter provide an effective date for the disclosures.

items.title: 【影像直擊COP31】潜海半世紀，點名簿上的地中海生物逐年缺席
items.summary: COP31在土耳其安塔利亞登場，談判桌外，海洋正在給出最直接的證據。本文記者隨海洋學者下潛地中海，見到的是另一幅景象：1970年代多到無處落腳的本土海膽已消失，取而代之的是來自紅海的入侵物種，海水升溫與蘇伊士運河拆除屏障，讓地中海成為暖化重災區。

items.title: Nature loss could cost SMEs a third of their profits, research reveals
items.summary: # Nature loss could cost SMEs a third of their profits, research reveals New research has found biodiversity loss is associated with a reduction equivalent to 36% of average small business profitability.

items.title: What CSRD and the EU omnibus changes mean for US and UK companies
items.summary: The Omnibus I Directive raised EU sustainability reporting thresholds to 1,000 employees and 450 million euros, pushing most non-EU groups out of scope or back to 2029.

items.title: Seven in ten supply chain emissions projects are profitable, finds CDP
items.summary: # Seven in ten supply chain emissions projects are profitable, finds CDP New analysis revealed that 69% of supply chain emissions reduction initiatives are profitable, paying back in a median of three years, but businesses are still not seizing these opportunities.

items.title: COP26 was a moment, but Glasgow’s businesses made it a movement
items.summary: # COP26 was a moment, but Glasgow’s businesses made it a movement Five years after COP26, Glasgow offers a distinctive example of how business leadership can turn climate ambition into innovation, economic opportunity and investment in the next generation, says Glasgow Chamber of Commerce's senior director, Alison McRae.
